<?php

namespace App\Models;

/**

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\ProductRequest;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Http\Resources\ProductResource;
use App\Services\ProductService;
use App\DTO\ProductDTO;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ProductController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ProductService $service
    ) {}

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $products = $this->service->getAll($request->query());
        return ProductResource::collection($products);
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(ProductRequest $request)
    {
        $dto = ProductDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $product = $this->service->create($dto);
        return new ProductResource($product);
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show(int|string $id)
    {
        $product = $this->service->find($id);
        return new ProductResource($product);
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(ProductRequest $request, int|string $id)
    {
        $product = $this->service->find($id);
        $dto = ProductDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $updatedProduct = $this->service->update($product, $dto);
        return new ProductResource($updatedProduct);
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(int|string $id)
    {
        $product = $this->service->find($id);
        $this->service->delete($product);
        return response(null, 204);
    }

}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\DTO\ProductDTO;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

class ProductService
{
    public function getAll(array $filters = []): Collection
    {
        $query = Product::query();

        foreach ($filters as $field => $value) {
            if (in_array($field, (new Product())->getFillable(), true)) {
                $query->where($field, $value);
            }
        }

        return $query->get();
    }

    public function create(ProductDTO $dto): Product
    {
        return Product::create(get_object_vars($dto));
    }

    public function find(int|string $id): Product
    {
        return Product::findOrFail($id);
    }

    public function update(Product $product, ProductDTO $dto): Product
    {
        $product->update(get_object_vars($dto));
        return $product->fresh();
    }

    public function delete(Product $product): bool
    {
        return $product->delete();
    }

}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\DTO;

use App\Http\Requests\ProductRequest;

readonly class ProductDTO
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $code,
        public string $slug,
        public string $title
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(ProductRequest $request): self
    {
        return new self(
            $request->input('code'),
            $request->input('slug'),
            $request->input('title')
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class ProductRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'code' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', \Illuminate\Validation\Rule::unique('products')->ignore($this->route('product'), 'code')],
            'slug' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', \Illuminate\Validation\Rule::unique('products')->ignore($this->route('product'), 'code')],
            'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
        ];
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Resources;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\JsonResource;

class ProductResource extends JsonResource
{
    /**
     * Transform the resource into an array.
     *
     * @param  Request  $request
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(Request $request): array
    {
        return [
                        'id' => $this->id,
            'code' => $this->code,
            'slug' => $this->slug,
            'title' => $this->title,
            'created_at' => $this->created_at,
            'updated_at' => $this->updated_at,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProductControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_can_list_products(): void
    {
        Product::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/products');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonCount(3, 'data');
    }

    public function test_can_create_product(): void
    {
        $data = [
            'code' => 'test_code',
            'slug' => 'test_slug',
            'title' => 'test_title',
        ];

        $response = $this->postJson('/api/products', $data);

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('products', [
                    'code' => 'test_code',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->getJson("/api/products/{$product->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonFragment(['code' => $product->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_update_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();
        $data = [
            'code' => 'test_code',
            'slug' => 'test_slug',
            'title' => 'test_title',
        ];

        $response = $this->putJson("/api/products/{$product->getKey()}", $data);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('products', [
                    'code' => 'test_code',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->deleteJson("/api/products/{$product->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(204);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('products', ['code' => $product->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_create_product_validates_required_fields(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/products', []);

        $response->assertStatus(422);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Services\ProductService;
use App\DTO\ProductDTO;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProductServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private ProductService $service;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->service = new ProductService();
    }

    public function test_can_get_all_products(): void
    {
        Product::factory()->count(5)->create();

        $result = $this->service->getAll();

        $this->assertCount(5, $result);
    }

    public function test_can_filter_products(): void
    {
        Product::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $result = $this->service->getAll([]);

        $this->assertCount(3, $result);
    }

    public function test_can_create_product(): void
    {
        $dto = new ProductDTO(
            code: 'test_code',
            slug: 'test_slug',
            title: 'test_title',
        );

        $product = $this->service->create($dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Product::class, $product);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('products', 1);
    }

    public function test_can_find_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();

        $found = $this->service->find($product->getKey());

        $this->assertEquals($product->getKey(), $found->getKey());
    }

    public function test_can_update_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();
        $dto = new ProductDTO(
            code: 'test_code',
            slug: 'test_slug',
            title: 'test_title',
        );

        $updated = $this->service->update($product, $dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Product::class, $updated);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_product(): void
    {
        $product = Product::factory()->create();

        $result = $this->service->delete($product);

        $this->assertTrue($result);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('products', 0);
    }
}
